category_title: Students who exhibit physical distress and avoidance in loud environments
scenario_title: Entering a loud gross motor room for sit-ups
minimal_context: The student is entering the gross motor room to perform sit-ups on a black mat.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are in the gross motor room now. Let's go to the black mat in the northwest corner to do our sit-ups.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins to cry and falls to his knees with his head on the floor as the door opens to the loud room with people coming in and out.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's time to work. Let's get ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues crying while scooting across the floor, easily distracted by the million noises in the room.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come over here. (Moves the student to the mat and into a sit-up position.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to cry and scoot across the floor, focusing on extraneous details that are unimportant to the development of the skill.)
